market.subtitle.zh: 浏览并安装 MCP 服务器、插件与技能。装完即可用——每一项都能当场验证。
market.subtitle.en: Browse and install MCP servers, plugins and skills. Every item can be verified on the spot, so nothing is installed but unusable.

market.readOnlyBackend.zh: 当前后端不支持安装，仅可浏览
market.readOnlyBackend.en: This backend can browse but not install

market.emptyMcp.zh: 没有匹配的 MCP 服务器

market.bundledHint.zh: 随本程序一起提供，无需下载，不需要网络
market.bundledHint.en: Ships with this install — nothing to download, no network needed

market.probeHint.zh: 真的启动这台服务器，并要求它完成一次 MCP 握手
market.probeHint.en: Really start this server and require it to answer an MCP handshake

market.probeOk.zh: 握手成功，暴露 {n} 个工具

market.installHint.zh: 写入你的 mcp.yaml（不用手改配置）
market.installHint.en: Write it into your mcp.yaml — no hand-editing

market.uninstallHint.zh: 从你的 mcp.yaml 里移除这一项
market.uninstallHint.en: Remove this entry from your mcp.yaml

market.pluginsNote.zh: 插件从磁盘直接加载，因此无需安装；此处列出的是当前生效的插件。
market.pluginsNote.en: Plugins load straight from disk, so there is nothing to install — these are the ones in effect.

market.remoteUnavailable.zh: 这个市场源暂时连不上
market.remoteUnavailable.en: This marketplace could not be reached

market.notInstallableHint.zh: 这个条目的来源里没有启动命令也没有地址，装不了 —— 点主页去看它怎么用
market.notInstallableHint.en: This entry carries neither a start command nor a URL, so there is nothing to install — open its homepage instead
